question: How should `/reasoning stream` be presented in the TUI: transient chat update, footer/status replacement, or only the existing Show thinking history path?
rationale: The source gap is clear, but the reporter explicitly asked for OpenAI/Grok-style overwriting and later footer/status placement, so automation cannot safely pick the durable TUI UX contract.

options.title: Transient Chat Reasoning
options.body: Render `agent stream=thinking` as a temporary chat entry that updates during the run and clears or collapses when the final answer arrives.

options.title: Footer Status Reasoning
options.body: Put the latest reasoning delta in the footer/activity status line, matching the later request but competing with existing run state.

options.title: History Only
options.body: Do not add live TUI reasoning presentation; instead fix docs/help so users rely on `/reasoning on` plus Show thinking history.

recommendation.title: Transient Chat Reasoning
recommendation.body: Render `agent stream=thinking` as a temporary chat entry that updates during the run and clears or collapses when the final answer arrives.

likelyOwner.reason: They introduced the `/reasoning` feature and are the strongest history-backed owner for deciding the TUI visibility contract.
